session_log_search_mask_before_truncatio.heading: PRG-001
session_log_search_mask_before_truncatio.description: search_session_logs.py の出力テキスト（検索語、見出しラベル、警告、ツール引数要約、抜粋）は窓分割や切り詰めの前に apply_mask を通す。
session_log_search_mask_before_truncatio.instructions: Does the Git diff in skills/session-log-search/scripts/search_session_logs.py emit or store any user-visible output text (search terms, heading labels, warnings, tool argument summaries, git subjects/stderr, or turn/document excerpts) without passing it through apply_mask (decision_hygiene.mask_secrets) before window splitting, truncation, or rendering?

criteria.true_description: The diff in skills/session-log-search/scripts/search_session_logs.py introduces or modifies code that outputs, truncates, or splits text (search terms, labels, warnings, tool summaries, git metadata, or excerpts) before passing it through apply_mask.
criteria.false_description: The diff does not modify skills/session-log-search/scripts/search_session_logs.py, or every new/modified output path in search_session_logs.py applies apply_mask before window splitting, truncation, and rendering.

session_log_search_rg_python_parity.heading: PRG-002
session_log_search_rg_python_parity.description: search_session_logs.py の rg 経路と Python フォールバック経路で同じ検索語集合（JSON エスケープ版を含む）と一致判定および除外判定を使う。
session_log_search_rg_python_parity.instructions: Does the Git diff in skills/session-log-search/scripts/search_session_logs.py introduce a divergence between the ripgrep prefilter path (prefilter_with_rg) and the Python fallback prefilter path (prefilter_python) in the expanded term set (including JSON-escaped variants from _term_variants_for_rg), case-insensitive matching semantics, or blocked-path filtering (is_blocked_path)?

criteria.true_description: The diff in skills/session-log-search/scripts/search_session_logs.py changes prefilter_with_rg, prefilter_python, or term expansion so that the rg path and Python fallback path use different term sets (such as missing JSON-escaped variants on one path) or different matching/exclusion rules.
criteria.false_description: The diff does not modify skills/session-log-search/scripts/search_session_logs.py, does not alter prefilter logic, or keeps prefilter_with_rg and prefilter_python aligned on the same term variants (_term_variants_for_rg), case-insensitive matching, and blocked-path checks.
